text: In Hull overall, GeoSensitivity shows modest positive spatial clustering with Moran’s I of 0.044 (p = 0.027), including seven areas of high GeoSensitivity near others like them. GeoSensitivity values vary widely, with a maximum absolute of about 24.2 but a mean absolute of 0.86, indicating varied geographic influence. The dominant local feature across most areas is "Crime roll mean 6," suggesting it’s worth examining further. Pattern scale is not established.
